title: Cleanup never deletes a live agent's build folders
why: Your ask (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh239AWxeRqxYqdRJxDTTE96w): the agent-end reap deletes DerivedData and .build while a process still runs, and the moment an agent ends, though a finished agent is resumed into its own worktree, so it rebuilds from nothing and loads the Mac.
note: Part 1, PR #720 (keep build folders while a process runs in the agent worktree): branch claude/project-thread-1jt01d 1ea149d, red twice (#718: a stale mutation anchor, fixed; #722: two old mutants in janitor/mutate_sweep.py survive with 0 red, "a folder with a live process cwd inside is renamed" and "a trash name with a live process cwd inside is deleted by the reap"). Fix: two direct tests calling agent_end_reap.reap_build_dirs(wt, cwds=[folder]), both mutants pointed at them, then one review. Doing: lane started Oct 27 CDT (orchestrator). Part 2, after #720: build folders follow the worktree's 30-minute idle clock, reaped only in agent worktrees idle 30 min or more at a later agent end, keeping #720's process gate (a long build makes no git activity). Windows runs the same code. Parked, later: what drove the Mac to load 123 (several xcodebuild and simulator runs at once?) and a proposed cap. Needs no answer. Port: no; the janitor installs from here. Placed ahead of c82 (triage, Oct 28): a lane is open on it now.
